189:t_014:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I mean no offense. I only wanted to know.」

189:t_014:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Do you want to stop being the quiet type too, like $n!?」

189:t_014:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll teach you what defeat feels like!」

189:t_014:9.en:
$n
「And I'll strip away that composure of yours!」

189:t_015:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Seven minutes have elapsed since the operation began...!」

189:t_015:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, hurry! If we can't annihilate the enemy within one more minute, we'll have to change our atmospheric-entry course!」

189:t_015:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「That would delay our arrival at $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$...!」

189:t_015:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, charge! We can't afford to waste time here!」

189:t_016:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Eight minutes have elapsed since the operation began! We can no longer enter the atmosphere on our planned course!」

189:t_016:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Damn...! Do we have to rethink the entire operation!?」

189:t_100:0.en:
$n
「$$尸空#pilot$$! It's time to pay you back for everything!」

189:t_100:2.en:
$n
「What are you talking about at a time like this!?」

189:t_100:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Either way, the factors are insufficient.」

189:t_100:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The essence of the $$いがみ合う双子$$... If you can't reach it, I have no use for you.」

189:t_100:5.en:
$n
「You might have no use for me, but I've got business with you!」

189:t_100:6.en:
$n
「I don't give a damn about the destiny between Reactors! I'll finish you here!」

189:t_101:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Thanks for what you did to us on $$翠の地球$$!」

189:t_101:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Unfortunately, I know even the smile the Boss taught me won't work on you...」

189:t_101:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「So today, I'm using brute force! Get ready!」

189:t_101:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wh-what...!? Why'd you suddenly call me by my nickname!?」

189:t_101:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I see... So this is causality.」

189:t_101:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Stop spouting nonsense! Does your emptiness mean your head's empty too!?」

189:t_102:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Well...? Have you decided to join us?」

189:t_102:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I won't listen to you after you invaded Earth.」

189:t_102:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「As long as I have 《$$グローリー・スター$$》's pride, I'll keep fighting!」

189:t_102:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「A star shining in the darkness... I see... So that's it...」

189:t_102:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルゴラ・グローリー$$...! Give me strength!」

189:t_103:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Of course they don't, $$ノノ$$! They're robots with combat AIs! They're different from you!」

189:t_103:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No, they're not. Every being has a heart!」

189:t_103:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's why $$ノノ$$ will fight you! $$ノノ$$ won't tolerate anyone ruled by an evil heart!」

189:t_104:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Enemy unmanned units entering combat range.」

189:t_104:1.en:
$$レド$$
「I wonder what makes you different from them...」

189:t_104:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is a $$パイロット支援啓発インターフェイス$$ System. Its purpose is established only through the existence of a pilot.」

189:t_104:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「From the development stage, this unit differs completely from enemy units whose weapon-control AIs are designed to annihilate humanity.」

189:t_104:4.en:
$$レド$$
「I know they're the enemy too. Let's do this, $$チェインバー#pilot$$...!」

189:t_105:0.en:
$$アル$$
「It's rather sad. AIs that simply carry out their missions without ever speaking, like those.」

189:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's how a weapon should be. You're the unusual one.」

189:t_105:2.en:
$$アル$$
「You are quite unusual yourself, Sergeant, combining life as a mercenary and a high school student.」

189:t_105:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「If I'm to master an unusual AI, I'll accept that I'm unusual too.」

189:t_105:4.en:
$$アル$$
「With respect, I would like to return that exact line of reasoning to you.」

189:t_106:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
(Those robots aren't to blame... The one who ordered them to fight is the real villain...)

189:t_106:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
(I'll fight...! Against anyone who uses robots for evil!)

189:t_106:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
(I'll use $$鉄人$$'s power for good and raise $$オックス$$ into a robot with an upright heart!)

189:t_107:0.en:
$$ナオト$$
「It's been a while since we were on Earth.」

189:t_107:1.en:
$$アキラ$$
「Both the Green and the Blue Earth are beautiful.」

189:t_107:2.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「And there are those who threaten them.」

189:t_107:3.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Fighting those enemies is the $$クラッシャー隊$$'s mission.」

189:t_107:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Let's go, everyone! To restore peace to Earth!」

189:t_107:6.en:
$$タケル$$
(I'll do it, Brother...! I dedicate my life and $$ゴッドマーズ$$' power to peace in this universe!)
